approved_amendments.scope: Approve the proposed direction in REP-STEWARD-021 and proceed to stage a separate draft WCS for lifecycle-standard materialization.
limits: This approval does not authorize Builder code changes.
This approval does not authorize package modification or cleanup.
WCS-022 remains a draft and requires separate review before materialization.

execution.objective: Prepare a bounded, reviewable Builder output lifecycle and qualification standard for this repository, based on the REP-STEWARD-020 evidence and the founder-approved direction.

proposed_decisions_for_review.proposal: Use PIC-001 as the contract for the execution package consumed by implementation engines; retain Builder specifications as process documentation unless their precedence is explicitly resolved.
Treat generated output as a Builder-produced candidate. Treat materialized output as a persisted artifact only after its lineage, integrity, and qualification state are recorded.
Require a passing qualification record, integrity evidence, source authority lineage, and a manifest before an output is represented as delivery-ready.
Do not automatically remove or collapse identical copies. Keep the LEAP-002 pair under REVIEW until its lifecycle roles are authoritatively established.

success_criteria: Reconcile PIC-001, active Builder contracts/specifications, the certified runtime contract, and BOQ-001 without silently treating conflicting documents as superseded.
Define ownership, provenance, meaning, and allowed transitions for generated, materialized, qualified, and delivery-candidate states.
Specify qualification and lineage evidence required before a package may be represented as delivery-ready.
Record the LEAP-002 identical archive pair as a lifecycle case study and keep it REVIEW unless authoritative evidence resolves its roles.
Identify unresolved conflicts or decisions instead of inventing authority.
No Builder scripts are edited or executed.
No package is regenerated, overwritten, moved, archived, or deleted.
No cleanup, deployment, runtime, database, Supabase, or secret-value changes.

unlocks: A separate WCS to materialize a lifecycle standard after this WCS is reviewed and approved.
A separate itemized cleanup WCS only if later lifecycle evidence supports cleanup.

forbidden_surface: Package creation, regeneration, overwrite, or mutation
Deletion, movement, rename, archive, or cleanup
Deployment, database, Supabase, and secret values

founder_runtime_test.expected_outcome: A draft lifecycle-policy WCS is staged for founder review.
